title: The Garden of the Crescent Cove
author: Cyrus Eastwick
blurb: August Nystrom, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
